name: (+/-)-AM-2233
summary: 2 nM at CB2 as the active (R) enantiomer. It was developed as a selective radioligand for the cannabinoid receptors and has been used as its 131I derivative for mapping the distribution of the CB1 receptor in the brain. AM-2233 was found to fully substitute for THC in rats, with a potency lower than that of JWH-018 but higher than WIN 55,212-2.

pharmacology.text: AM-2233 is a drug that acts as a highly potent full agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with a Ki of 1.8 nM at CB1 and 2.2 nM at CB2 as the active (R) enantiomer. It was developed as a selective radioligand for the cannabinoid receptors and has been used as its 131I derivative for mapping the distribution of the CB1 receptor in the brain.

uses.text: It was developed as a selective radioligand for the cannabinoid receptors and has been used as its 131I derivative for mapping the distribution of the CB1 receptor in the brain.

summaryZh: AM-2233，化學名：1-[(N-甲基-2-哌啶基)甲基]-3-(2-碘苯甲醯基)吲哚，分子式C22H23IN2O，屬於亞歷山德羅斯·馬克里揚尼斯小組合成的苯甲醯基吲哚類AM系列大麻素，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: It was built as a tracer rather than a drug: with radioactive iodine attached, it let scientists photograph where CB1 receptors sit in the living brain.
fact.zh: 它原本是為了當示蹤劑而非藥物設計的：接上放射性碘後，科學家便能拍攝活體腦中 CB1 受體的分布位置。
fact.zhHans: 它原本是为了当示踪剂而非药物设计的：接上放射性碘后，科学家便能拍摄活体脑中 CB1 受体的分布位置。
